# Aura Downloader
> Free online all-in-one social media video, photo, and audio downloader.

## Supported Platforms
- YouTube (Videos, Shorts, Playlists, Audio MP3)
- Instagram (Reels, Posts, Stories, Carousels)
- Facebook (Videos, Reels)
- TikTok (Videos without watermark, MP3 audio)
- Pinterest (Video pins, Image pins)
- X / Twitter (Videos, GIFs)
- LinkedIn (Videos, Documents)
- Snapchat (Spotlight, Stories)
- Spotify (Tracks, Playlists metadata)
- Threads (Photos, Videos, Carousels)
- Reddit (Videos, Audio, GIFs)

## Key Features
- High-definition video downloads (1080p, 4K, 720p, 360p)
- Audio extraction (MP3 / AAC format)
- No registration or login required
- Instant media extraction with fast download speeds
- Safe, private, and free to use
